entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I totally freaked out... He really did have[n]a change of heart...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And we were lucky his mind didn't get[n]messed up either! This was an A+ job!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Does this mean that they won't have a[n]mental shutdown even if their Palace[n]disappears?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I see... So we need to persuade the[n]Shadow without killing it, and then[n]send it back to its real self.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Our targets won't undergo a cognitive[n]collapse if we do that.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, we can get 'em to confess with[n]no bad stuff?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey! That works for me!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do you have to be so loud?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't worry about it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So... how'd it go? With Shiho, I mean...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She's regained consciousness!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It was only for a little bit, but I got to[n]talk to her!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I was able to tell her that Kamoshida[n]admitted to what he did!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shiho, she... she told me she was sorry...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Looks like she found out that I was flirting[n]with Kamoshida for her sake...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And here I was, wanting to apologize[n]to her.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Kamoshida's at fault for all this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I know...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shiho's mom is thinking of transferring[n]her to another school after she recovers.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The whole sexual harassment and[n]attempted suicide... people will[n]label her after that.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sounded like Shiho had the same idea too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's gonna get lonely...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But, I think it's for the best... I'm sure[n]it'll be hard if she stays here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She's alive. You can see her anytime.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...I need to change too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That aside, I was surprised you could[n]hold yourself back against Kamoshida's[n]Shadow.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It wasn't like that... I just wanted[n]Kamoshida to apologize himself.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're so kind, Lady Ann.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No matter how much of a shitbag he[n]was, finishing him off woulda left a bad[n]aftertaste, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? That's not it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think revenge is better served if I make[n]him repent.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Realizing what he's done, he'll grovel for[n]forgiveness the rest of his life, you know?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I just believe there are fates worse than[n]death.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Holy shit...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A-Anyways, that's all settled...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But you know, there was one more thing[n]I was wonderin' about that castle.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why was Kamoshida the only one who[n]had that Metaverse thing?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It isn't necessarily limited to him.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's something anyone could have if their[n]heart became warped from their desires.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyone...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wanna check it out?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: N-Not right now. We better lay low for[n]a while. People are still gonna be talkin'[n]about Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then again, it's totally impossible for[n]someone to find out what we did at[n]his Palace.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, about that... Weird rumors about[n]you guys are already going around.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Stuff like, you got together and threatened[n]Kamoshida with something close to[n]physical violence...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: People aren't going to easily believe that[n]phantom thieves really exist.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The calling card's being treated like it[n]was a prank by someone who knew what[n]Kamoshida was doing.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Makes sense...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're the ones who did it, and I still don't[n]completely believe it myself.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let's wait for things to settle down for[n]the time being.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, let's check how much this[n]medal can be sold for.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It'd be better if we pawned it off ASAP.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ooh, got a hit!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Wait, thirty thousand yen!? That's all[n]a gold medal's worth!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Remember that time in middle school?[n]I lent you some money.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's no way I borrowed thirty[n]thousand yen from you!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wouldn't it be around that much with[n]compounded interest?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Interest my ass!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm not saying that I'm taking all of it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, it's your fault for not paying me[n]back all these years! It's just common[n]sense!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I agree on laying low and keeping an eye[n]on the situation.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: However, you dragged me into this.[n]It would be nonsense not to celebrate[n]a successful mission.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess we could blow this dirty money[n]on something fun.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Discussions among phantom thieves are[n]to take place over luxurious food. How[n]about it?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, wait—

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Nah, I guess it's fine. There's somewhere[n]I want to go then.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Where's that?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's a place Shiho and I have been wanting[n]to go for a while.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I owe money, so I can't complain...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can eat something like that whenever[n]we want.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude!? Why're you even goin' there!?[n]This conversation's obviously headed[n]to us eatin' out!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll leave it to your discretion as well,[n]Lady Ann.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'll call and check the prices later then.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: When should we go? Wanna do it soon,[n]like tomorrow?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why don't we go on the last day of[n]the holidays?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It'll help energize us when school life[n]starts up again the day after.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then... the 5th, on Children's Day.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So, who's going to sell this?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Leave that to us. We know a store that'll[n]buy anything. Don't we, [fName]?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay, I'll leave that to you guys.
